title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip: AI-assisted video highlights and social clips
friendlyTitle: AutoClip turns long videos into draft highlight clips
summary: AutoClip is an MIT-licensed Python and TypeScript application for finding highlights, aligning subtitles and exporting edited video, including vertical formats for short-video platforms. The actively updated project has about 7,850 GitHub stars and gained roughly 325 stars in the day’s trending snapshot.
friendlySummary: AutoClip uses AI to find useful moments, line up subtitles and export videos in common formats. It has about 7,850 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Creators can test a self-hosted workflow for turning long recordings into draft clips, while developers can connect it through its CLI or MCP interface and configure local-model options. Human review remains important for context, copyright, speaker consent and cuts that change meaning.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce the first editing pass for podcasts and long recordings. Check every clip before publishing so the edit keeps the speaker’s real meaning.
